clips.title: The story
paras: High Executor Darthalia is a high-ranking Forsaken military commander stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Acting under the direct authority of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, she directs Forsaken operations against the human stronghold of Southshore and local Syndicate brigands. Her leadership is central to securing the Horde's southern flank in Lordaeron.

Operating out of Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia serves as the operational commander for Forsaken forces throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills. Her primary strategic concern is halting the expansion of human resistance, keeping the Alliance forces in Southshore contained, and hunting down the lawless Syndicate rogues infesting the surrounding countryside. Every offensive push into southern Hillsbrad flows directly through her command.
